topic: One service stopped sending traces after deploy
symptom_pattern: Since a deploy, one Python service stopped sending traces; a Node service on the same host still shows up. App logs show nothing obviously broken.
root_cause: The Python service's DD_AGENT_HOST was changed to localhost (or dropped, defaulting to localhost), so inside its container traces are sent to itself.
resolution_path: Run ddtrace-run --info / check tracer startup logs for the agent URL and errors
Set DD_AGENT_HOST to the Agent service name
info_needed: env vars of affected vs healthy service

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the tracer startup log line for the affected service?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: It says agent_url: http://localhost:8126 and agent_error: Connection refused.

qa_pairs.tse_question: What changed in this morning's deploy?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: We moved env vars into a new config map, nothing that should matter.

customer_style.tone: busy, a bit impatient, under deadline
